_comment: Pinned upstream commit SHAs for MoonRay-related dependencies. MoonRay is under active development (build/GPU/API surfaces change frequently); this file is the single source of truth for which upstream commit each vendored artifact, doc reference, and future source integration corresponds to. Update deliberately, not automatically, and record the reason in this file's history via git log.

openmoonray.notes: Not yet vendored/built locally; recorded as of first UPSTREAM_LOCK creation for future integration. This is the reconciliation anchor superproject commit: moonray/scene_rdl2/moonshine below were verified 2026-09-09 (via GitHub API) to match the submodule gitlinks this commit's tree actually pins, not fetched independently as separate 'latest main' snapshots. Phase 03 must re-verify against this commit's .gitmodules/tree before building, since openmoonray's main branch moves.

moonray.notes: Not yet vendored/built locally; recorded as of first UPSTREAM_LOCK creation for future integration. Verified 2026-09-09: matches the moonray/moonray submodule gitlink in the openmoonray superproject at commit b9b0ac29135b26e20a51edf9028558bb64df6700 (see openmoonray.notes above).

scene_rdl2.notes: Not yet vendored/built locally; recorded as of first UPSTREAM_LOCK creation for future integration. Verified 2026-09-09: matches the moonray/scene_rdl2 submodule gitlink in the openmoonray superproject at commit b9b0ac29135b26e20a51edf9028558bb64df6700 (see openmoonray.notes above).

docs.notes: Matches the commit already vendored under docs/vendor/openmoonray/UPSTREAM.json (developer-reference subtree).

moonshine.notes: Not yet vendored/built locally. Recorded because DwaBaseMaterial (dso/material/DwaBase) and the rest of the DWA production shader set live here, not in moonray/scene_rdl2 core; confirmed via GitHub API at this commit while grounding docs/bridge/SCENE_TRANSLATION.md's material mapping. Required only if DwaBaseMaterial is chosen as the Principled-BSDF target in Phase 07 -- moonray core also ships UsdPreviewSurface (dso/material/UsdPreviewSurface) as a lower-dependency alternative. Also verified 2026-09-09 to match the moonray/moonshine submodule gitlink in the openmoonray superproject at commit b9b0ac29135b26e20a51edf9028558bb64df6700 (see openmoonray.notes above).

blender.notes: Installed and verified on real hardware in Phase 02 (docs/completions/02-host-runtime-foundation.md, docs/evidence/phase02-host-evidence.md). commit is the full git SHA of the v5.2.1 tag on https://github.com/blender/blender (confirmed via GitHub API 2026-09-09); its first 12 hex chars match the build hash 9e2066aef7ef that the installed Blender binary itself reports. binary_sha256 was verified during Phase 02 against Blender's officially published checksum for this archive.
